integrity: All expressions and an exact-rational reproducibility checker are embedded. No independent mathematical, novelty, or publication-priority validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Identical planar self-propelled particles with independent orientation dynamics, complete-graph harmonic attraction, and no direct positional noise; stationary centroid-relative statistics, not time-integrated currents. The pairwise squared-radius covariance is small at large population size. A general moment-contraction identity and known single-particle fourth moments are credited as prior mathematics.
title: Finite-population sign reversal of radial cofluctuations in harmonically coupled active particles
